svg.title: goPool benchmark heat map
svg.desc: Heat map of all numeric values in the mining.submit and mining.notify benchmark tables from the July 6, 2026 rerun. Each metric column is colored independently; green is better and red is worse.
svg.text: Rerun July 6, 2026. Every numeric table value is a tile; green is better, red is worse.

g.text: Rows are pool/miner-count runs. Latency is ms.
